citations.claim: Agent-Diff — state-diff contract with a closed-world side-effect invariant :: Agentic task success on enterprise API workflows judged purely by the resulting environment state change, with any unexplained mutation counted as a task-killing side effect. Nine LLMs, 224 tasks, containerized replicas of Slack/Linear/Box/Google Calendar.
citations.metric_definition: State diff DeltaS(tau) = Diff(S0, S1) of inserted/deleted/updated entities across all DB tables. Success is judged on DeltaS ONLY, never on the action trace. Closed-world invariant: every change in DeltaS must be explained by a required assertion or involve only explicitly ignored fields; any other insertion, deletion, or mutation is a side effect and fails the task outright (contributes zero even with partial progress). Score = assertion-weighted, clean(tau) x satisfied assertions / total assertions. Pass = binary, clean AND all assertions satisfied.
citations.number: 9 LLMs x 224 tasks (48 Box, 59 Slack, 57 Linear, 60 Calendar; 108 unique endpoints; mean horizon n*=5.3). Overall assertion-weighted scores 38.0 (Llama-4-Scout) to 88.1 (DeepSeek-v3.2). 2,016 traces per model (224 tasks x 9 runs); 4,032 traces LLM-judge annotated. Cost efficiency spread 33x (Grok-4.1-Fast $0.01/test vs Claude-Haiku-4.5 $0.22/test).

Escalation rate = fraction of actions sent to the human. Reviewer reliability r(l) = max(r_min, 1 - slope*max(0, l - C)) with capacity C, slope 0.02, r_min 0.2.
